use_cases: Displaying user profile pictures in SaaS applications
Showing avatar fallbacks when images fail to load
User identification in comment sections and dashboards
Avatar display in messaging and notification interfaces
Profile picture rendering in social and collaboration tools
ai_summary: A minimal Avatar component built with Radix UI primitives for displaying user profile pictures with automatic fallback to initials when images fail to load. Provides three sub-components: Avatar container, AvatarImage, and AvatarFallback for flexible composition.
